canonicalization.encoding: UTF-8, ASCII keys/IDs/identity strings only; no Unicode normalization; reject any codepoint>127 or control character unless represented as JSON string escape within an explicitly ASCII textual field
canonicalization.object_order: ASCII lexicographic keys, no duplicate keys
canonicalization.separators: comma and colon, no spaces; json ensure_ascii=true, sort_keys=true, allow_nan=false; exactly one LF
canonicalization.integers: base10 without plus/leading zeros; no booleans in integer fields; exact arbitrary-precision parsing; integer-valued fields stay integers
canonicalization.rational: object {numerator:canonical signed decimal STRING,denominator:canonical positive decimal STRING}; gcd=1, denominator>0; zero only {numerator:"0",denominator:"1"}; never -0
canonicalization.decimals: parse proposed table decimal lexemes exactly with Decimal then reduced Rational in semantic numeric fields, never via binary64
canonicalization.arrays: use per-kind ordering in generation/snapshot specs; never sort chronological event arrays
canonicalization.raw_hash: SHA256 exact file bytes, independent of semantic preimage digest
canonicalization.runtime_payload: separate RUNTIME_CANON_PY312_F64_V2, Python3.12 json shortest binary64 repr, sort_keys/compact/allow_nan=false/one LF; no header self-ID; normalize -0; only future scientific adapter can emit this family

worker_invocation_contract.semantic_options: Exactly empty array in v2; no extra ignored flags
worker_invocation_contract.path_rule: All paths deterministic within approved CALIBRATION root from already-known IDs, resolved against actual cwd; forbid path traversal/symlinks; all flags exact, reject extras. Actual argv retained independently of semantic hash.
worker_invocation_contract.guard: Private worker must apply the same source/approval/seed/descriptor guard even if called directly; absent/invalid authorization rejects before generating/invoking. No bypass CLI. Templates are proposed protocol, module currently absent.

preimage_scope_notes: BLUEPRINT and EXECUTION_PLAN never include actual payload/workload/run/attempt IDs or resolution receipts.
Generation receipt includes actual invocation/logs/timestamps AFTER materialization.
WORKLOAD ID excludes generation-attempt/timestamps/receipt hashes; a valid resolution receipt is a prerequisite for publishing it, not a semantic self-reference.
RUN semantic argv excludes actual output/attempt paths. Exact actual argv is separately recorded and checked against deterministic rendering after attempt ID exists.
Current schema is an unapproved document, not installed into any pipeline.

canonical_array_orders.assignments: K order, never sort by effect
canonical_array_orders.selected_condition_ids: registered scene COCKPIT/ADAS/FUSION, load light/medium/near-saturation, size8/16 order
canonical_array_orders.event_records: actual contiguous event_seq order, never sort by state digest

conditional_semantics.GROUP_METRICS: Only H_ISOLATED L may be NOT_APPLICABLE_CONTROL/count0/all numeric fields null; applicable groups require prescribed exact counts and nonnull finite values. Wrong absence invalid.
conditional_semantics.PROCESS_RESULT: SPAWN_FAILED/NOT_STARTED=>process_started false,started_at/exit null; unknown interrupted exit stays null; COMPLETE requires started true,actual exit0 and all raw refs.
conditional_semantics.DIAGNOSTIC_RECORD: VALID_FULL=>positive nonnull b,nonnull o/delta/g and enumeration digest, best feasible set includes baseline; eligible incomplete fields use ERROR_RECORD. Partial not computed g=null, never a zero negative.
conditional_semantics.SCIENTIFIC_INPUT_ENVELOPE: Lineage must prove real approved generator/parent MAIN derivation; merely changing origin/seed/fixture_derivation is rejected.
conditional_semantics.SCIENTIFIC_RUN_RECORD: COMPLETE iff all stage contract per_trial_complete conditions proven; false/missing/unknown cannot satisfy.
conditional_semantics.STAGE_RECORD: No COMPLETE or exit0 shortcut to progression; all explicit conjunction fields checked; NOT_FROZEN always blocks.

effective_family.legacy_defs: All61 v2 defs preserved verbatim as reference components; never accept legacy complete records as V3 substitutes
effective_family.activation: All applicable exact-document approvals plus separate implementation validation and execution authorization required; this document cannot satisfy activation

v3_conditional_semantics.context: Observed relevant files must exactly match frozen source bundle path/hash roster; relevant dirty/untracked must be false. Complete observed fields and matching raw evidence required; actual HEAD may differ in metadata-only commits, with distinct context/run identities.
v3_conditional_semantics.provenance: PRE_SPAWN and POST_EXIT OBSERVED receipts for every actually started required process; identical immutable context across boundary, same subject/role/host and expected repository; failure/null/missing or changed context closes operation. Failed/not-started records may preserve FAILED observations but cannot COMPLETE.
v3_conditional_semantics.run: execution_context_sha256 matches RUN_PREIMAGE_V3, run record, process and complete provenance inventory; inventory includes generation/primary/replay/validator/metric evidence; raw refs and semantic digest both verified.
v3_conditional_semantics.m2: COMPLETE analysis requires exact selected18 x registered10 x B1/B3/B4/B5 roster=720; missing/duplicate/mismatch/invalid all0, valid720; all report refs and independent semantic verification present.
v3_conditional_semantics.stage: New M2 dimensions plus inherited state required; execution COMPLETE never implies M2 analysis VALID. Progression also requires explicitly selected/approved F01/F02, all M2 prerequisites, timing and original stage conjunction.
v3_conditional_semantics.identity_adapters: Existing ATTEMPT/RUN_LOCK/REPLAY wrappers may bind already-known V3 run ID as ID; new typed_family/contract hash fixed in execution plan before generation. Original KEY/random encoding unchanged. Cross-family legacy receipts cannot be silently relabeled.
